headline: Spotify adds Talk to Spotify voice control feature
summary: Spotify introduces voice command feature for playlist creation and music info
details: Spotify has introduced a new feature called 'Talk to Spotify' that allows users to control the app with voice commands or text. This feature is currently available in beta for Premium users aged 18 and older in the US, Ireland, and Sweden.

Users can access the feature from the Home or Now Playing views on mobile devices. They can issue commands such as 'play some artists I haven't heard before' and then fine-tune it by saying 'add some Bad Bunny' or 'make it more upbeat.'

The feature also allows users to learn more about songs, artists, and podcasts by asking questions like 'what is the inspiration behind Dua Lipa's Radical Optimism?' or 'When was this album released?'

headline_marked: 1Password launches AI Spend Management [[for token costs]]
headline: 1Password launches AI Spend Management for token costs
summary: 1Password introduces AI Spend and Consumption Management to track AI token spend
details: 1Password has launched AI Spend and Consumption Management, a new capability in its SaaS Manager platform. This tool provides a unified, real-time view of how organizations consume and spend on AI services from vendors like Anthropic, Cursor, and OpenAI.

The product connects directly to vendor admin APIs to pull token-level consumption data daily. It normalizes this data into a single dashboard, allowing organizations to set spend limits, configure alerts, and break down usage by team, user, vendor, and model.

The move targets the challenge of managing consumption-based AI costs, which can be chaotic due to varying token costs and usage patterns. Traditional SaaS pricing operates on a per-seat, per-year model, but AI pricing does not.

Goldman Sachs estimates that token consumption from AI agents alone will grow 24 times by 2030. 1Password's new capability aims to help organizations manage this growing spend and avoid 'paying far more than they needed to, for far longer than they should have.'

The AI Spend and Consumption Management feature is available to all 1Password SaaS Manager customers at no extra cost. It is currently in public preview, with broad availability planned for fall 2026.
